Harry Styles in Phoenix, April 2–3, 2027: State Farm Stadium parking, drop-off and the ride home

Scottsdale Sprinters’ short answer: Harry Styles plays State Farm Stadium in Glendale on Friday, April 2, and Saturday, April 3, 2027, both nights at 7:45 p.m. The stadium recommends buying parking ahead on SeatGeek, every lot is cashless, and rideshare and drop-offs use the Black Lot south of the stadium. For a group, one chauffeured vehicle replaces the lot, the exit line and the drive home.

Last updated: September 25, 2026

When is Harry Styles in Phoenix?

Harry Styles plays State Farm Stadium in Glendale on two nights, Friday, April 2, and Saturday, April 3, 2027, on the Together, Together Tour 2027. Both shows start at 7:45 p.m., as the stadium’s event page lists them; it does not publish a doors time. State Farm Stadium is at 1 Cardinals Drive, Glendale, AZ 85305, the home of the Arizona Cardinals, beside Desert Diamond Arena and the Westgate Entertainment District off Loop 101. From Old Town Scottsdale it is about 36 minutes by Google’s typical drive time without event traffic; from Phoenix Sky Harbor about 27. Two stadium nights in a row means two full nights of traffic on the same roads. Book your night, not just the weekend.

Where do you park for Harry Styles at State Farm Stadium?

The stadium’s Harry Styles page recommends buying parking in advance through SeatGeek, and every parking area at State Farm Stadium is cashless. Staff and Glendale police direct cars to the lots with room, so you do not pick your lot on the night. Concerts set their own lot hours, separate from Cardinals game days: check the event page before you leave. Our State Farm Stadium guide has the lot map, the exit routes and the full parking answer. Or skip the lot: a chauffeured group heads for the Black Lot, the stadium’s named drop-off and pickup, and nobody waits in the exit line after the encore.

Where is the drop-off and rideshare pickup for Harry Styles?

State Farm Stadium names the Black Lot, south of the stadium across Cardinals Way, as its drop-off and pickup for rideshare and for family and friends. No limo or charter lane is published, so the exact spot for a chauffeured vehicle follows the event’s traffic plan on the night. Every rideshare guest uses the same point after the show, which is where the waits build. A booked vehicle meets the group at a point agreed before the show and leaves once everyone is aboard.

What bags are allowed at the Harry Styles concert?

One clear bag up to 12 by 6 by 12 inches, or a one-gallon clear freezer bag, and the stadium strongly recommends bringing no bag at all. Small non-clear bags up to 4.5 by 6.5 inches are allowed under the stadium’s clear bag policy; coolers are not. Once you leave the stadium there is no re-entry, and a group that is dropped off has no car in the lot to leave a bag in. Settle bags before pickup.

How should a group plan a Harry Styles night?

Work back from the 7:45 p.m. start: a pickup that lands the group at the Black Lot well before the show leaves time for security, merchandise and finding seats in a stadium this size. Book by the hour and the vehicle is yours for the whole night, dinner at Westgate included, or book a ride there and a ride back. Tell us which night, April 2 or April 3, when you book: each is its own date. Coming from out of town? We pick up at Phoenix Sky Harbor and at any Valley hotel, and the same vehicle can take the group to the show.

Which vehicle fits a group going to Harry Styles?

Our pick for Harry Styles is the Ultra Luxury Party Sprinter, $250 an hour with a 4-hour minimum, seating 15. A VIP night takes the Maybach Jet Sprinter (9 seats), the Maybach Shuttle Sprinter or the Luxury SUV (Suburban); a friend crew takes the Limo Party Sprinter (12-13 Pax) or the Limo Party Sprinter (16 Pax); a big group takes the Party Bus (28 Pax) (28 seats). The Ultra Luxury Party Sprinter has fiber-optic lighting with eighteen modes, lasers and a fog machine, an ultra-premium sound system and a partition with an intercom to your chauffeur. The Limo Party Sprinter (12-13 Pax) is $175 an hour with a 4-hour minimum and the Limo Party Sprinter (16 Pax) is $175 an hour with a 4-hour minimum; the Party Bus (28 Pax) is $250 an hour with a 4-hour minimum. Every rate prices the whole vehicle, before tax, so one more rider does not change it. For a family or a group that wants a quieter ride, the Executive Black Sprinter seats 14 in reclining leather, and the Mini Bus (24 Pax) seats 24. Reach the reservations team at (623) 986-6339 or reservations@scottsdalesprinters.com with the show, the pickup address and the rider count. Count riders for the ride home as well as the ride there.
